name: Paston
summary: Armenian three-player trick-taking game where players bid for trump and must win six tricks as declarer.
rules_text: Three players use 32 cards A K Q J 10 9 8 7. Deal 10 each plus 2 face-down prikup in 2-card batches. If bottom card is 7 of spades redeal. First bidder is holder of Jack of spades, then dealer left thereafter. Bidding clockwise: pass or name higher trump in order spades < clubs < diamonds < hearts < best spades. Highest bidder becomes declarer. If all pass, Jack holder is declarer. Declarer takes prikup and discards two facedown, then announces trump at least as high as bid (except best spades only if bid). He may surrender for -10. Opponents in turn say whist to defend or pass. If both pass declarer wins without play. If both whist each needs 2 tricks; if one whists he needs 4. Play clockwise: declarer leads, follow suit if able else must trump. Highest trump or highest led suit wins trick. Score: spades base, clubs x2, diamonds x3, hearts x4, best spades x4 except declarer win is only +10. Declarer 6+ = +10 else -10. Whist scores depend on tricks won. First to 121 total wins; exactly -121 resets to 0.
